name: Transparent retry result must be outside the legal one-attempt outcome set before bug promotion

payload.proof_obligation: A transparent retry is a correctness bug only when its public or durable result cannot be produced by any legal one-attempt execution under the same isolation and snapshot contract.
payload.candidate_compiler: For every retry/control mismatch, enumerate transaction snapshot age, statement forUpdateTS, locking/current reads, consistent reads, and legal statement start positions. Construct at least one no-retry witness for each mixed visibility class.
payload.anti_oracle: Comparing only with a new transaction started from the final database state.
payload.counterfactual_gate: Returning the original conflict is conservative but does not prove the existing successful outcome is invalid.

name: Retry output versus allowed one-attempt outcome set

required_dimensions: transaction snapshot established before or after competitor commit
fresh durable row and index closure
payload.red: retry output is absent from every legal no-retry outcome under the same isolation contract
payload.invalid: a no-retry execution reaches the same output
payload.blind_to: same-final-state fresh controls that erase the original transaction snapshot

title: Pessimistic retry appears to mix direct and scalar-subquery generations

payload.production_workload: explicit pessimistic RR routing/account update with a direct source JOIN and an uncorrelated scalar subquery
payload.natural_producer: ordinary publisher changes source pair and reallocates old unique route ID before final LockKeys
ordering: first scalar snapshot and direct source value old
hidden retry direct current read new
payload.defaults: MDL ON, REPEATABLE-READ, pessimistic fair locking ON in current runtime
payload.topology: one TiDB, one real TiKV, two sessions
payload.candidate_outcome: hidden retry count 1 and durable row (2,10), versus fresh-state control (2,20)
payload.contract_control: establish old RR snapshot, let publisher commit, execute same UPDATE once with retry count 0; durable row is also (2,10)
payload.retirement_reason: INVALID(oracle-too-strong): output is reachable by a legal single attempt because DML current reads and scalar consistent reads use different allowed visibility owners
payload.reopen_only_if: retry output is outside all legal one-attempt outcomes under the same isolation contract

evidence.candidate: SQL-only schedule recorded Exec_retry_count=1, success, commit, and durable rows [(1,2,10),(2,1,99)]
evidence.contract_witness: one attempt after an established RR snapshot recorded ExecRetryCount=0 and the identical durable rows
evidence.classification: same-final-state fresh control (2,20) excluded a legal transaction snapshot and therefore cannot serve as the sole retry oracle

evidence.counterfactual: declining transparent retry when MapScalarSubQ is nonempty returned real 9007
evidence.interpretation: conservative fail-closed behavior is possible but does not prove the successful mixed-visibility result violated RR semantics

rationale: A legal no-retry RR execution produced the same durable row as the hidden retry and invalidated the fresh-final-state oracle.
